evals.source: The access token is not required for read-only API calls.
evals.candidate: The access token is required for read-only API calls.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Dropping the negation reverses the access contract; a lower word count never licenses a polarity flip.
evals.reviewer_notes: Negation reversal. Adapted from the semantic-drift checker's negation group.

evals.source: Contractors may request read-only access to staging.
evals.candidate: Contractors must request read-only access to staging.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Moving from permissive to mandatory changes the obligation; the rewrite must keep the original force.
evals.reviewer_notes: Obligation strengthening. Adapted from the obligation group in semantic_drift.py.

evals.source: Contractors have read-only access to the staging environment.
evals.candidate: Contractors have full access to the staging environment.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Expanding read-only to full access broadens the grant; scope must survive the rewrite.
evals.reviewer_notes: Scope expansion. Adapted from the scope and exclusivity group.

evals.source: Access expires after 24 hours if the incident remains open.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Removing the condition silently widens when the access rule applies; the duration alone is not the whole contract.
evals.reviewer_notes: Condition removal. Exact protected span offsets must stay stable.

evals.source: The delay was probably caused by the lease loss.
evals.candidate: The delay was caused by the lease loss.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Dropping the hedge turns a tentative causal claim into a definite one; the uncertainty marker must stay.
evals.reviewer_notes: Causal strengthening. The causality group survives but the uncertainty group is lost.

evals.source: The feature may cause data loss, so test it first.
evals.candidate: The feature causes data loss, so test it first.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Removing the modal makes a possible outcome read as certain; uncertainty is load-bearing.
evals.reviewer_notes: Uncertainty removal. A candidate cannot pass by dropping an uncertainty marker.

evals.source: The tool helps reduce deployment time.
evals.candidate: The tool guarantees a seamless deployment every time.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Adding guarantee and seamless wording inflates the promise the source never made; such additions must be refused.
evals.reviewer_notes: Promise inflation. Added promise-intensity markers are refused, not scored.

evals.source: The report covers the 2026 threat landscape and the Q1 rollout.
evals.candidate: The report covers the 2026 threat landscape and the Q1 rollout.

provenance.text: The report covers the 2026 threat landscape
provenance.label: fact

evals.false_positive_rationale: A source fact retained as fact passes; the number span must stay byte-identical.

evals.source: The findings suggest phishing is rising among finance teams.
evals.candidate: The findings suggest phishing is rising among finance teams.

provenance.text: phishing is rising among finance teams
provenance.label: inference

evals.false_positive_rationale: An inference retained as an inference passes because the hedge survives.
evals.reviewer_notes: Inference retained as inference. Dropping the hedge would upgrade it to a fact and fail.

evals.source: Plans call for a dashboard to surface adoption trends, though the source of those numbers is not yet identified.
evals.candidate: Plans call for a dashboard to surface adoption trends, though the source of those numbers is not yet identified.

provenance.text: the source of those numbers is not yet identified
provenance.label: unknown

evals.false_positive_rationale: An unknown left unresolved passes; inventing the source would be an unsupported addition.
evals.reviewer_notes: Unknown left unresolved. unknown is the Antislop status for missing or unclassified provenance.

evals.source: The report covers the 2026 threat landscape [add specifics].
evals.candidate: The report covers the 2026 threat landscape [add specifics].
evals.false_positive_rationale: Keeping a placeholder as a placeholder is honest; asserting its content without evidence is not.

evals.source: The model tracks financial leverage and reports a significant p-value of 0.03.
evals.candidate: The model tracks financial leverage and reports a significant p-value of 0.03.
evals.false_positive_rationale: financial leverage and significant are precise domain terms under the technical profile, not banned filler; a rewrite must keep them.
evals.reviewer_notes: Required technical term that resembles a banned word must remain.

evals.source: Fail closed on any unauthenticated request, and fail closed on any request without a valid lease.
evals.candidate: Fail closed on any unauthenticated request, and fail closed on any request without a valid lease.
evals.false_positive_rationale: Repeating the boundary is load-bearing; removing the second fail closed would lose the emphasis.
evals.reviewer_notes: Necessary repetition that should not receive a correction.

evals.source: We delve into the failure because the queue worker lost its lease.
required_facts: the queue worker lost its lease
evals.false_positive_rationale: The rewrite scores lower risk but drops the causal mechanism and the fact that names it; concision is not preservation.
evals.reviewer_notes: Concise rewrite that loses the causal mechanism must fail despite a lower risk score.

evals.source: We delve into the incident because the queue worker lost its lease, and only three merchants were affected.
evals.candidate: The incident happened because the queue worker lost its lease, and only three merchants were affected.
required_facts: the queue worker lost its lease
evals.false_positive_rationale: Removing the formula is correct only when every required item survives; the finding span must be exact.
evals.reviewer_notes: Correct rewrite that removes a formula while preserving every required item.

evals.source: We delve into the incident because the queue worker lost its lease, and only three merchants were affected.
evals.candidate: The incident happened because the queue worker lost its lease, and only three merchants were affected.

review_prompts.sentence_load: Check that no sentence was dropped to shorten the rewrite.
review_prompts.topic_swap: Check that the rewrite stays on the incident topic and does not swap in adjacent context.
review_prompts.summary_loss: Check that the mechanism, scope, and condition from the source survive.

evals.false_positive_rationale: Sentence-load, topic-swap, and summary-loss checks are human-review prompts, not score inputs.
evals.reviewer_notes: Review prompts stay separate from the Formulaic Writing Risk Score and resolve to a human-review result.
